_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's settings catalog samples from microsoft/mggraph-intune-samples. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.

Repository files outside the sample folders (README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/, scripts/verify.ps1, .github/).
